meta.name: add-codex
meta.description: Use Codex (OpenAI's codex app-server) as a full agent provider — planning, tool orchestration, MCP tools, server-side history, session resume — alongside or instead of Claude. ChatGPT subscription or OpenAI API key, vault-only via OneCLI. Per-group via `ncl groups config update --provider codex`. Distinct from using OpenAI as an MCP tool (where Claude remains the planner).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用 Codex 替代或配合 Claude 作为智能体规划器
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 Claude 之外使用 Codex 作为智能体核心规划器
copy.tagline_en: Use Codex as a full agent provider alongside or instead of Claude
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to use Codex as the primary agent planner instead of or alongside Claude

howto.what: 装上后,NanoClaw 多了一个 codex 后端,可让群组改由 OpenAI Codex 执行而不是 Claude。切换后 Codex 负责规划与工具编排,支持 MCP 工具、服务端历史与会话续接;密钥只放 vault。
howto.when: 安装后不会自动接管。要生效,需在主机上执行 `ncl groups config update --provider codex` 并重启目标群组;也可在操作者同意后设为新建群组默认。

say.text: 把群组 42 的 provider 切到 codex 并重启。
say.note: 该群组的请求改由 Codex 处理。

say.text: 把新群组默认后端设为 codex 前,先问一下操作者。
say.note: 需操作者确认后才改默认值。

howto.what_en: Installs Codex as a NanoClaw agent backend (alongside or instead of Claude). Once a group is switched, Codex does planning and tool orchestration, with MCP tools, server-side history, and session resume; credentials stay in the OneCLI vault.
howto.when_en: Installation does not take over automatically. It applies after setting a group's provider to codex and restarting it; optionally, after operator confirmation, it becomes the default for new groups.

say_en.text: Install the codex provider for NanoClaw and complete OpenAI login.
say_en.note: Runs the install steps and provider auth.

say_en.text: Switch group 42 to codex and restart it.
say_en.note: That group's requests are then handled by Codex.

say_en.text: Before defaulting new groups to codex, ask the operator first.
say_en.note: Needs operator confirmation before changing the default.
